articles.title: What Is Cisco Systems (CSCO) Really Gaining From Its New AI Alliances?
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS: CSCO) announced new AI-focused alliances with DXC Technology and Qumulo on 19 November 2026. The DXC partnership integrates Cisco AI-driven network intelligence into DXC's orchestration platforms to speed up incident resolution for large enterprises. The Qumulo collaboration links Cisco smart switches with Qumulo storage monitoring so ransomware activity can trigger real time, automated network isolation.
